pages.text: Stuck on the rocks or a beach and can't sail off? Any of her crew can have her $(l)towed off$() to open water nearby: the $(l)Free her$() button on the quest table's Ship tab, or $(l)/crew free$(). She comes up level and at rest, and her crew aboard come with her.
It only works when she's really aground, and once every few minutes. Patch her up first: a crash at speed holes the hull.
